name: A claim lands with an underline and a through-line dot
looks: A two-line statement sets up small then lands huge on its second line, a hand-drawn underline swiping on beneath the big word and a small accent dot sitting at its end like punctuation. A thin HUD timeline bar runs along the bottom edge with a labelled keyframe marker showing where in the reel this beat sits.
build: First line fades in small and light; second line lands heavier and larger a beat later (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out). The underline draws on left to right (`strokeDashoffset`, ~250ms) once the big word lands, the accent dot popping in last at its end. The HUD timeline bar runs the whole shot with a single labelled tick marking this beat.
sound: A soft swell under the setup line, a confident thud as the big word lands, a quick swipe sound under the underline.
prompt: Land a short claim in two weights, a quiet setup line followed by a heavier, bigger payoff line, drawing a hand-style underline beneath the payoff the instant it lands and capping it with a small accent dot, with a thin labelled timeline bar running along the bottom edge throughout.
